mapper.select: SELECT member_id,nickname,avatar_url,phone,status,create_time FROM mall_member 1=1 AND nickname LIKE concat('%',#{nickname},'%')AND phone LIKE concat('%',#{phone},'%')AND status=#{status} ORDER BY member_id DESC
SELECT member_id,app_id,open_id,union_id,nickname,avatar_url,phone,status,create_time FROM mall_member WHERE app_id=#{appId} AND open_id=#{openId}
mapper.update: UPDATE mall_member SET last_login_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE member_id=#{memberId}
mapper.select: SELECT address_id,member_id,receiver_name,receiver_phone,province_code,province_name,city_code,city_name,district_code,district_name,detail_address,is_default FROM mall_member_address WHERE member_id=#{memberId} AND del_flag='0' ORDER BY is_default DESC,address_id DESC

SELECT address_id,member_id,receiver_name,receiver_phone,province_code,province_name,city_code,city_name,district_code,district_name,detail_address,is_default FROM mall_member_address WHERE address_id=#{addressId} AND member_id=#{memberId} AND del_flag='0'
mapper.update: UPDATE mall_member_address SET receiver_name=#{receiverName},receiver_phone=#{receiverPhone},province_code=#{provinceCode},province_name=#{provinceName},city_code=#{cityCode},city_name=#{cityName},district_code=#{districtCode},district_name=#{districtName},detail_address=#{detailAddress},is_default=#{isDefault} WHERE address_id=#{addressId} AND member_id=#{memberId} AND del_flag='0'
UPDATE mall_member_address SET del_flag='2' WHERE address_id=#{addressId} AND member_id=#{memberId} AND del_flag='0'
UPDATE mall_member_address SET is_default='0' WHERE member_id=#{memberId} AND del_flag='0' AND is_default='1'
UPDATE mall_member_address SET is_default='1' WHERE address_id=#{addressId} AND member_id=#{memberId} AND del_flag='0'
UPDATE mall_member SET status=#{status} WHERE member_id=#{memberId}
